verdict.rationale: The pack documents cost visibility: a monthly cost estimate extrapolated from recent workload, a page for reviewing Request Unit consumption, and guidance on diagnosing resource-heavy queries. None of it shows a configurable spend cap, spend limit or usage alert that would stop or flag a runaway bill. Cost estimates and RU review are adjacent monitoring features, not the capability this story asks for, so the applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As a founder, I can set spend caps or usage alerts so a runaway query or traffic spike cannot produce a surprise bill
